Descriptions.zh: 艾米丽和海莉是亲姐妹，艾米丽是姐姐。
Descriptions.en: Emily and Haley are sisters; Emily is the older one.

Descriptions.zh: 亚历克斯和艾芙林是祖孙关系，艾芙林是他的祖母。
Descriptions.en: Alex and Evelyn are grandson and grandmother.

Descriptions.zh: 亚历克斯和乔治是祖孙关系，乔治是他的祖父。
Descriptions.en: Alex and George are grandson and grandfather.

Descriptions.zh: 乔治和艾芙林是相濡以沫的老夫妻。
Descriptions.en: George and Evelyn are a long-married elderly couple.

Descriptions.zh: 山姆和乔迪是母子关系，乔迪是他的母亲。
Descriptions.en: Sam and Jodi are son and mother.

Descriptions.zh: 山姆和文森特是亲兄弟，山姆是哥哥。
Descriptions.en: Sam and Vincent are brothers; Sam is the older one.

Descriptions.zh: 文森特和乔迪是母子关系，乔迪是他的母亲。
Descriptions.en: Vincent and Jodi are son and mother.

Descriptions.zh: 玛鲁和罗宾是母女关系。
Descriptions.en: Maru and Robin are daughter and mother.

Descriptions.zh: 玛鲁和德米特里乌斯是父女关系。
Descriptions.en: Maru and Demetrius are daughter and father.

Descriptions.zh: 玛鲁和塞巴斯蒂安是同母异父的兄妹，关系有些疏远。
Descriptions.en: Maru and Sebastian are half-siblings; their relationship is a bit distant.

Descriptions.zh: 塞巴斯蒂安和罗宾是母子关系，但塞巴斯蒂安常感到被忽视。
Descriptions.en: Sebastian and Robin are son and mother, though Sebastian often feels overlooked.

Descriptions.zh: 塞巴斯蒂安和德米特里乌斯是继父子关系，关系较为紧张。
Descriptions.en: Sebastian and Demetrius have a strained stepfather-stepson relationship.

Descriptions.zh: 阿比盖尔和皮埃尔是父女关系，但阿比盖尔常与父亲意见相左。
Descriptions.en: Abigail and Pierre are daughter and father, though they often clash.

Descriptions.zh: 阿比盖尔和卡罗琳是母女关系。
Descriptions.en: Abigail and Caroline are daughter and mother.

Descriptions.zh: 皮埃尔和卡罗琳是夫妻，共同经营种子商店。
Descriptions.en: Pierre and Caroline are a married couple who run the seed shop together.

Descriptions.zh: 潘妮和潘姆是母女关系，潘妮时常照顾酗酒的母亲。
Descriptions.en: Penny and Pam are daughter and mother; Penny often looks after her alcoholic mom.

Descriptions.zh: 贾斯和玛妮是侄女与姑妈的关系，由玛妮抚养。
Descriptions.en: Jas and Marnie are niece and aunt; Marnie raises Jas.

Descriptions.zh: 贾斯和谢恩是侄女与舅舅的关系，谢恩非常疼爱贾斯。
Descriptions.en: Jas and Shane are niece and uncle; Shane cares deeply for Jas.

Descriptions.zh: 谢恩和玛妮是外甥与姑妈的关系，谢恩住在她家。
Descriptions.en: Shane and Marnie are nephew and aunt; Shane lives with her.

Descriptions.zh: 雷欧和威利是忘年之交，威利照顾过雷欧。
Descriptions.en: Leo and Willy share a close bond; Willy looked after Leo.

Descriptions.zh: 山姆和塞巴斯蒂安是多年好友。
Descriptions.en: Sam and Sebastian are longtime best friends.

Descriptions.zh: 山姆、塞巴斯蒂安和阿比盖尔是一起组乐队的好朋友。
Descriptions.en: Sam and Abigail are bandmates and close friends, often with Sebastian.

Descriptions.zh: 塞巴斯蒂安和阿比盖尔是亲密朋友，一起玩乐队。
Descriptions.en: Sebastian and Abigail are close friends who play in a band together.

Descriptions.zh: 亚历克斯和海莉是相互欣赏的朋友，性格上有些相似。
Descriptions.en: Alex and Haley are friends who share a similar confident personality.

Descriptions.zh: 艾利欧特和莉亚都是艺术家，彼此惺惺相惜。
Descriptions.en: Elliott and Leah are both artists who appreciate each other's creative spirit.

Descriptions.zh: 哈维和艾利欧特是邻居，偶有往来。
Descriptions.en: Harvey and Elliott are neighbors who occasionally interact.

Descriptions.zh: 法师和卡罗琳之间有一段神秘的过去。
Descriptions.en: The Wizard and Caroline share a mysterious past.

Descriptions.zh: 潘妮和玛鲁是朋友，常在图书馆相遇。
Descriptions.en: Penny and Maru are friends who often meet at the library.

Descriptions.zh: 莱纳斯和罗宾是老朋友，彼此尊重。
Descriptions.en: Linus and Robin are old friends who respect each other.
